cmd:
set -e
cd /root/Iryna_Karmazina && git fetch -q origin claude/direct-automation-expeditor-671esy
B=origin/claude/direct-automation-expeditor-671esy
git show $B:direct_sync/expeditor-direct-sync.service > /etc/systemd/system/expeditor-direct-sync.service
git show $B:direct_sync/expeditor-direct-sync.timer   > /etc/systemd/system/expeditor-direct-sync.timer
cp -n /root/deals_trigger.py /root/deals_trigger.py.bak-0730
python3 - <<'PY'
p='/root/deals_trigger.py'; s=open(p).read()
old="'/root/deals_sync_once.py'"
new="'/root/direct-sync/expeditor_direct_sync.py'"
assert old in s, 'рядок запуску не знайдено'
s=s.replace(old,new).replace("timeout=180","timeout=600").replace("stdout.decode()[-200:]","stdout.decode()[-300:]")
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('TRIGGER_PATCHED')
PY
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now expeditor-direct-sync.timer >/dev/null
systemctl restart deals-sync-trigger.service
sleep 3
echo "TIMER: $(systemctl is-enabled expeditor-direct-sync.timer) $(systemctl list-timers --no-pager expeditor-direct-sync.timer | sed -n 2p | awk '{print $1,$2,$3}')"
echo "TRIGGER: $(systemctl is-active deals-sync-trigger.service)"
TOKEN=$(cat /root/deals-sync-trigger-token)
echo "BUTTON TEST: $(curl -s --max-time 300 "http://127.0.0.1:8788/run?token=$TOKEN" | head -c 200)"
